notes.title: 《我要写小说》创意工坊开放啦！
notes.content:
各位“小说家”们，大家好！最近一段时间我们研究了创意工坊，因为第一次制作创意工坊，所以用了比较久的时间，让大家久等了。
本次更新的创意工坊教程我们已经制作了文档，感兴趣的小伙伴可以自行查看。
https://docs.qq.com/doc/DZlpyTUZXSnlNU254?&u=2bc4a7feaa364f81b7e4765291c63e0d
接下来是本次创意工坊的一些可以制作的详细内容，不感兴趣的小伙伴可以无视啦。

友情提示：打开表格后可以将其复制到Excel中编辑更加方便。（复制前先将Excel单元格设置成文本模式再进行复制）

项目标识：
RoleConfig：角色表，里面为角色的各项数据。
RoleLabelConfig：标签表，里面为题材、角色会使用到的标签ID。
RoleSkillConfig：角色技能表，里面为角色技能的各项数据。建议只更改数据，如果需要更改技能类型，那么可以找技能中已存在的相似技能将其数据复制到需要修改的地方后再进行更改。不可添加新的技能类型。
SubjectConfig：小说类型表，里面为小说的大类型分类。如果在ThemeConfig中添加了新的题材数据则要将其对应的分类到该表中。
ThemeConfig：素材题材表，里面为所有的题材以及其题材数据。
ThemeFitConfig：题材契合度表，里面为不同题材对应类型（Subject）的契合度百分比。
WorldConfig：世界题材表，里面为世界题材的数据。
EventConfig：随机事件表，里面为随机事件的文本及其效果。

非常感谢各位“小说家”们的支持与关注，你们的每一个好评对我们都是极大的鼓励，让我们有了前进的动力。也希望各位“小说家”们能够在以后的日子里多多支持我们。谢谢！

notes.title: 写小说重大更新！连载模式上线！
notes.content:
本次更新内容为大版本更新，我们做了详细的分类，玩家可以根据分类自行查看。

连载玩法说明：
玩家可以通过开坑来开始书写一本连载书籍，开坑以后可以通过本书的各项情况选择继续连载、完结此书还是直接下架。
玩家连载书籍每次连载或者开坑都会根据书本的审核状态获得网站的推广，最高推广等级为S。根据不同的推广书籍将会获得初始的热度，热度会每天自然下滑，当然玩家可以通过爆更不断地通过网站推广获得热度，也可以自己炒作获得热度。
注意：热度很重要，如果热度低，再好的书也不会有多少人看，靠自来水是活不下去的。
在连载的过程中，每次连载都可以更改书本的副题材和配角，当然确定的主题材和主角是不能更改的了。
当书本有一定的阅读量且质量达标的时候，网站会与作者签约开启订阅，玩家可以通过订阅获取大量收益。如果玩家在此网站入驻还会开启月票功能，可以有资格参加月票排行榜的打榜资格。
当作者入驻网站以后，网站还会根据当前书本的火爆程度跟作者签署IP合作，作者需要帮IP合作完成剧本创作才可以获得相应的报酬。
好啦，大概玩法已经介绍差不多了，更多内容请“小说家”们去游戏内自行探索。

notes.title: 开发进度85％
notes.content:
各位“小说家”们，大家好呀！今天早上路过小学的时候看到校门口好多大巴车，他们在组织春游啊......好羡慕！在这里提前祝大家端午节快乐呀！

又到了开发进度汇报的时刻了。目前开发进度预估应该在85％了，如果快的话，也许6月底就可以发布了。

这段时间主要是完成了一个很复杂，从重制版本初就开始制作的一个大功能，因为之前不确定能不能做好，所以并没有在开发进度中透露，不过最近我们终于完成了这项功能，并达到了让我们自己初步满意的程度，所以可以拿出来说一下啦。

这个功能就是主角功能，大家也知道，写小说嘛，肯定是有男主，女主，男配，女配的，所以我们在设计重制版的时候就准备加入这个内容，让写小说变得更有意思。

首先玩家需要构思角色来获得角色，构思角色需要消耗大量灵感。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41673925/ba76778094ddd599a8449c0e205b69b5ac4d8de8.png[/img]

然后会获得角色，如果获得重复角色，会转化为重复角色的经验值。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41673925/72974d2c6af7c2550dfda959ab46abe77bc5c62f.png[/img]

角色会有自己擅长的元素，以及自己的技能，有些角色同时出场会有技能组合效果。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41673925/6ad78d597caaa6028bb18326ff2714c50fb5792c.png[/img]

然后在选择题材的时候，可以看到题材右下角有能上阵的角色性别，蓝色为男性，粉色为女性。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41673925/e70e9bb1184d20d0f01635a520640bad289f7b9f.png[/img]

一本书会有主副题材，所以总共可以出场4个角色，至于上阵角色会产生什么效果，玩家可以根据自己拥有的角色和题材自由搭配，如果角色有所选择题材的擅长元素，将会增加本书的属性哦。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41673925/55bd4897406780f225a62adbda054134d352d615.png[/img]

出场的角色将会和作家一起完成整本书的写作。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41673925/78342ddec4880770f04446ef3d13f7d0a1008bf5.png[/img]

本功能就介绍到这里，更多的内容等我们游戏更新以后大家自行探索吧！

最后，提前祝大家端午节快乐！同时非常感谢各位“小说家”们的支持与关注，你们的每一个好评对我们都是极大的鼓励，让我们有了前进的动力。也希望各位“小说家”们能够在以后的日子里多多支持我们。谢谢！

notes.title: 开发进度70％
notes.content:
各位“小说家”们，大家好呀！又到了开发进度汇报的时刻了。大概估算了下，目前开发进度应该在70％了。

         接下来的开发进度也许会慢一些，因为我推翻了一些东西，我想要让玩家玩我们游戏的同时，还能了解到一些小说的真实历史。所以我最近也在各种查证，各种考古，各种找远古帖子了解当初的小说历史。（因为年代久远，我发现这一内容真的很难搞，至于最终成品里到底包含不包含这个内容，现在我也没办法给大家明确的答复，不仅仅是技术上的难关，还有各种历史久远实在是无法考证的事件都很难查，度娘都搜不到一丁点信息.....）

          好啦，扯远了，我们接下来说一些有意思的东西吧。

最近我们在研究一个很有意思的东西，就是怎么让玩家看书评的时候有更有趣的感觉，然后我们就想到了书评互动，什么叫书评互动呢？请看以下示意图。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41673925/562afd644d8b7a2ef8922561980ffd98331faec5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41673925/67d5813d32d9ce8e86285f308caa5198c48a440b.png[/img]

notes.title: 开发进度50％
notes.content:
各位“小说家”们，又见面啦！接下来进行最新开发进度汇报，目前开发进度预估50％啦！是不是很快呢？
因为很多小伙伴们觉得我们之前的玩法很像出版社的做法，所以我们干脆就把以前的玩法改良了一下，做成了出版社的运营模式。当然因为是模仿我国早期出版模式，所以肯定不会是电脑码字啦，就是手写滴。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41673925/1c772c72e90086acd0915e55dbcda57b30081c42.png[/img]
但是光有这种模式根本不能让玩家体验到现在写小说的代入感，很多小伙伴可能比较年轻，根本没有经历过那个年代的实体书时代，所以我们绞尽脑汁最后决定，将游戏的玩法体量扩充，以后游戏的正式版将会包含“出版社出版”“线上完本”“线上连载”等玩法。
但是这将意味着我们的游戏体量将会几何倍增加，所以这次重置版本第一版我们暂定只包含“出版社出版”和“线上完本”这两个玩法，“线上连载”将会在重置版上线以后我们再加紧后续制作出来。
以下是“出版社出版”的一些展示图。
此为自费出版，自费出版需要自己承担出版风险，根据评分等数据自己估算售卖份数然后印刷，如果到下架仓库还有多余的书籍，会按照旧书价格折算给你，所以次出版方式推荐熟练写手使用。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41673925/47b24e8d202b946217066711d715e87d3f1614d3.png[/img]     [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41673925/da6dd1b0bb647151530a4ac6c525605f14210780.png[/img]

此为出版社签约出版，签约出版的书籍虽然获取利润很低，但是没有任何风险，推荐给小白使用。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41673925/d0fe4e8c33045e4083118a0ea559b4fd8ba6979e.png[/img]     [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41673925/462388d0c9333b0ef1670ee2944ea42c2d07620a.png[/img]

“线上完本”的玩法还在进一步制作中，我们将会在下一次的进度汇报里展示。
在这段时间里我们不仅进行了玩法的制作和整体的改良，还优化了一些更贴心的设计，比如当你点不到墙背后的物品怎么办？所以，我们设置了高墙和矮墙模式，在矮墙模式下你可以将墙体隐藏起来，能让整体空间更整洁同时更容易操作，以下是展示效果。

墙壁显示状态
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41673925/944400ae895414988213ed83c6e6c60c8a2b1c6c.png[/img]
墙壁隐藏状态
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41673925/d248dcd0cf3f586dfcbfec37b4a028deb76a3079.png[/img]

好啦，这次的进度汇报差不多结束了，虽然我们在加班加点的赶制新版本，但是大家游戏评论中提到的建议和扣扣里的提的意见我们都有收集和整理，也受到了很多启发，希望大家继续多多提意见哦！

然后......不要嫌我啰嗦哈，大家一定要注意防疫哦，最近我们这里形式又有点严峻了，我们也随时准备好了线上工作的准备，希望疫情早点好起来。
    
        最后，祝大家五一快乐！同时非常感谢各位“小说家”们的支持与关注，你们的每一个好评对我们都是极大的鼓励，让我们有了前进的动力。也希望各位“小说家”们能够在以后的日子里多多支持我们。谢谢！


PS：如果有什么建议或者意见，游戏BUG反馈都可以加入我们交流群：120067130反馈给我们。

notes.title: new version 10％
notes.content:
Hello, all "novelists" in the new version, during this time we are working hard to make the new version, and the program is also rewriting the underlying framework.

The game framework has changed beyond recognition, so I took the art team to draw and design new content. However, while designing, I feel that the art does not seem to have a lot of work before the program can fully run. What are you talking about? Beating a child on a rainy day is also idle. Since the workload of art is far less than that of programming, why don't we do something more meaningful? So my head was hot again, and I made a decision that I don't know if it was the right one: optimize the style of painting!

As we all know, there are two main determinants of the style of the game: the first is the UI, and the second is the scene.
So we redesigned and discussed the UI, and released several versions in the middle, and finally settled on a good version to make our game look a little better.
This is our new UI design! Isn't it so good looking?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41673925/5694fc514abfd3d0b90e1b09965fa47fcb1d829d.png[/img]

After calculating the workload, the current progress of the new version should be about 10%, but we are confident that it will be completed in the shortest possible time! (Before because of the epidemic, all of us were locked at home for 6 days, and the art was locked at home for 10 days. This gave birth to my idea of ​​​​modifying the UI. After all, working and communicating at home... The efficiency is indescribable. Hope In the next days, the epidemic situation will change quickly!)

Well, the progress report before the Qingming Festival is almost that much. After the festival, we will improve the UI and continue to optimize our scene, so that the combination of the scene and the UI can make our game look more comfortable (Niu X). notes.title: About the new version plan
notes.content:
Hello fellow "novelists", after nearly ten days of planning and discussion, as well as a long and exhausting brainstorm (I feel like everyone in the team is dying), we have combined all the players who have received the game since its release. Our suggestions and suggestions, as well as a lot of ideas and ideas for the follow-up of the game, and then combined with the existing gameplay, content, etc. of our game, and finally made a very difficult decision: we decided to redo "I want to write a novel" ".
        Because the game framework designed by "I Want to Write a Novel" was too fragile (I didn't expect players to have so many ideas at the time), and the design was not so comprehensive. After all, we are newbies. As a result, we were inspired by the suggestions of players after the launch, and wanted to add more and more things. This framework and some of the original designs are no longer enough to support these huge ideas. If the current version is changed, it is possible to integrate some content, but forcing it in will cause the current game to become unstable and full of hidden dangers (not to mention incomplete).
       We're a small team with very limited staff, and redoing the game represented a lot of time. So I wrote an explanation to explain to the players the reason why we will not update for a while (of course, the bugs in the current version will definitely be fixed in time), I am afraid that when we are doing the reset, the players think we have already Abandoned this game.
       Regarding the new version, we have basically determined the content and entered the intense final planning stage. Next, we will do our best to present the new game to the majority of players as soon as possible. From today onwards, we will release it from time to time. Some of our research and development progress.
       Finally, I would like to thank all the "novelists" for their support and attention. Every praise from you is a great encouragement to us and gives us the motivation to move forward. I also hope that all "novelists" can support us in the days to come. Thanks!


PS: If you have any suggestions or comments, game BUG feedback can join our exchange group: 120067130 feedback to us.

notes.title: About new content planning
notes.content:

When the project of "I Want to Write a Novel" was first established, the purpose of the game was to simulate a writer's life. Of course, because of the game, many things could not be reflected in the game or expressed (such as the serialization that everyone is very concerned about). , if there are 2 themes for serialization, will it be written to death as long as there are 2 themes? Are other themes still useful? Isn't the system going to crash directly? Wait for these problems that we haven't thought about, of course, this is not the only problem, there are many strange and unsolvable problems).
Of course, in any case, we are very happy with everyone's tolerance and support for "I Want to Write a Novel", and we have received feedback from players through this game, which has allowed us to grow very quickly.
Therefore, we are re-planning the follow-up content of this game based on the suggestions and suggestions of the players, as well as many ideas and ideas for the follow-up of the game. This will take a certain amount of time. Please wait patiently for the "novelists" Let's take a moment, thank you!

notes.title: For foreign players:
notes.content:
We recently encountered a problem that some foreign players reported that the game was stuck after entering the game. After searching for the problem, we found that it was caused by the incompatibility of the WINDOWS system language with the language transcoding of the game. Because this kind of problem is the underlying problem of the game, it has exceeded our current capability, and we cannot solve it by updating the game. Here we figured out a way to play the game smoothly.
You can download a third-party language transfer tool, such as "Ntleas", use this tool to change the language region of the game to "chinese" and open it to play the game. Tools need to use 64-bit (x64)
Sorry for your troubles, I would like to express my sincere apologies to the players of our game.

- Translated from Google
